trigger_alert.summary: Webhook delivery failures and growing backlog on webhook-dispatcher

logs.msg: TLS handshake failed: certificate for webhook-dispatcher expired 2026-09-01, rejecting outbound connections
queue depth exceeded max capacity (10000), dropping webhooks

ground_truth.root_cause: webhook-dispatcher's TLS certificate expired, causing every outbound handshake to fail; the resulting retry backlog then overflowed the queue and forced webhooks to be dropped
